user.title: Connect to TeamCity
user.description: Create an access token in TeamCity under Profile → Access Tokens. The token's permissions decide which projects Home Assistant can see.

data_description.token: A TeamCity access token. It needs permission to run builds if you want to use the trigger buttons.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate with TeamCity
reauth_confirm.description: The access token for {url} is no longer valid. Enter a new one.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to TeamCity. Check the URL and that the server is reachable.

abort.already_configured: This TeamCity server is already configured.

init.title: Build configurations
init.description: Choose the build configurations to add to Home Assistant. Leave empty to add all of them.
